summary: Creates a texture/data COM object via a vtable call on an interface pointer fetched from this+0 dereferenced plus 16312, sets or overrides its type, computes a network send payload length from a flag word, dispatches the object over the network, and releases the temporary object. Returns success of the send dispatch.

operations.description: Derive a boolean flag from bit 27 of the flag word.
Create a COM object via the vtable at offset 0x60 on the interface stored at this+0 dereferenced plus 16312.
If custom type is -1, mark the object default type by setting byte at object+4 to 1; otherwise invoke the object vtable method at offset 12 to set the custom type.
Select send code and flag from type selector: 1 yields code 1, 2 yields code 2 with flag 1, anything else yields code 0.
Dispatch the created object over the network with derived flags, code, length and context; set success flag when dispatch returns zero.
Release/destroy the temporary COM object via virtual method dispatch.
Return success flag: 1 when the network dispatch returned zero.

clean_pseudocode: if (!NetworkSendDispatch(flag_word, ((flag_word >> 8) & 0x3FF) + 8, obj, packet_flag, code, send_context, write_flag))
unresolved: Meaning of the 16312 (0x3FB8) interface offset and the exact object type created are not derivable from this function alone.
